name: Маска перезарядки
subject: ONE translucent charcoal QUARTER DISC only. Two perpendicular straight radii and one stepped circular outer edge. No frame. Alpha-translucent fill.
prompt_override: Create ONE flat 2D PIXEL ART cooldown overlay mask, no decorative UI component. A PLAIN charcoal QUARTER OF A CIRCLE, one homogeneous translucent dark fill, two exactly perpendicular straight radii and a crisp stair-stepped arc. TRANSPARENT background outside; uniform partial alpha inside. ABSOLUTELY NO border, metallic rim, rivet, brass corner, inner line, highlight, shadow, text, button, ornament, panel or icon. One simple mask only, generous clear margin. Reference used for crisp square pixel scale only; do not copy its sword or frame.
caption: Пиксельный UI-компонент с прозрачным внешним фоном. Это визуальный референс; runtime-экспорт и проверка в движке не выполнены.
